info.title: API.SH: Airbnb
info.description: The Airbnb API from API.SH: public Airbnb data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Day-by-day availability of an Airbnb listing for up to 24 months: open or blocked, check-in/check-out allowed, minimum and maximum nights. Plain JSON request. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/airbnb-calendar

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Airbnb experience: title, summary and description, category, host (name, title, picture, about), price per guest (with the struck-through original price), rating, review and written-review counts, duration and language, location and meeting point, what's included, things to know, the agenda, guest requirements, accessibility, next available dates, photos and recent reviews.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/airbnb-experience

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An experience link (`airbnb.com/experiences/<id>`) or its numeric id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Airbnb Experiences in a place, 20 a page: title, summary, category, rating and review count, price per guest (with the struck-through original price), duration, ticketed or not, badges, booking messages, photos and link. Filter by dates, guests, price, duration, experience type, featured tags, who it suits, time of day, language and accessibility; `filters` lists every option with the value to pass back.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/airbnb-experiences

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A city or place, e.g. `Paris, France`.

parameters.name: min_duration
parameters.description: Minimum duration (as the site's duration filter takes it).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Experience types, comma separated (`value` of the `taxonomy` options, e.g. `Tag:9010` for architecture).

parameters.name: featured
parameters.description: Featured tags, comma separated (values from the `experience_featured` options).

parameters.name: traveler_types
parameters.description: Good for (values from the `experience_traveler_type` options, e.g. kids, big groups).

parameters.name: time_of_day
parameters.description: morning, afternoon or evening, comma separated.

parameters.name: languages
parameters.description: Language ids, comma separated (values from the `host_language` options, e.g. 1 for English).

parameters.name: accessibility
parameters.description: Accessibility tags, comma separated (values from the `accessibility` options).

parameters.name: tickets
parameters.description: Ticketed experiences only (the value from the `experience_tickets_filter` option).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Pagination: pass the cursor from `next_cursor` on the previous response; `next_cursor` is null on the last page. `bbox` limits results to a map area.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/airbnb-search

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum nightly price (in the listing currency).

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Comma-separated Airbnb amenity ids (4 wifi, 5 air conditioning, 7 pool, 8 kitchen, 9 free parking, 33 washer, 34 dryer, 30 heating, 25 hot tub).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from `next_cursor` on the previous response; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Map area: ne_lat,ne_lng,sw_lat,sw_lng (north-east and south-west corners), e.g. 48.865,2.36,48.85,2.33. Only listings inside it.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
